items.title: Playbook + proposal types and learning-store read/write for playbooks.json + proposals/
items.context: experience-layer-types.ts: PlaybookProposal {id, title, trigger{keywords,fileKinds,storyPhases}, check, pitfalls[], verification[], lineage{sourceStoryId,sourceFindingId,sourceSignature}, status:'proposed', proposalDigest}; Playbook {..., status:'proposed'|'candidate'|'active'|'stale'|'archived', usage{surfacedCount,resolvedHits,dismissedHits}}. learning-store.ts: read/write .lattice/learning/playbooks.json + proposals/<id>.json (atomic). Zero outward imports except core/digest.js.
items.userSees: Build clean; the smoke round-trips a proposal and a playbook through learning-store; proposalDigest = digestCanonicalJson(proposal domain).

happy.desc: learningStore.writeProposal(validProposal) -> file created at proposals/<id>.json with all fields; readProposal(id) returns identical object; WHY: round-trip persistence proves atomicity and field fidelity
computeProposalDigest(proposal) -> returns a stable hex string; calling twice with same input yields identical digest; WHY: proves determinism which is prerequisite for fail-closed approve

learningStore.writePlaybook(candidatePlaybook) -> written to playbooks.json; readPlaybooks() includes it with status=candidate and usage counters at zero; WHY: proves playbook persistence path separate from proposals

edge.desc: computeProposalDigest excludes the proposalDigest field itself from hash input -> digest of proposal-with-digest equals digest of proposal-without-digest; WHY: prevents circular dependency in digest computation
writeProposal with id containing path-traversal characters (e.g. ../etc/passwd) -> either sanitized or rejected, never writes outside proposals/; WHY: path traversal safety
readProposal for non-existent id -> returns null or throws clear not-found error (not crash); WHY: boundary for missing data
readPlaybooks on empty/missing playbooks.json -> returns empty array, not crash; WHY: cold-start resilience

adversarial.desc: import analysis of learning-store.ts and experience-layer-types.ts -> zero imports from handlers/, findings, gates, or any module outside core/digest.js; WHY: enforces the import-fence guardrail non-vacuously
writeProposal called concurrently with same id -> last-write-wins or atomic error, never corrupted JSON; WHY: concurrent write safety

items.title: playbook_propose + playbook_diff + playbook_reject handlers
items.context: handlers/playbook.ts: playbook_propose --finding <id> reads the finding (via the finding subsystem) + its signatureTag, builds a staged proposal with lineage + proposalDigest (digestCanonicalJson from core/digest.js), writes proposals/<id>.json. playbook_diff <proposalId> renders read-only what approve would write (no mutation). playbook_reject <proposalId> discards the proposal. Never calls finding_add or any gate.
items.userSees: playbook_propose --finding <id> prints a proposalId + digest; playbook_diff shows the rendered candidate; playbook_reject removes the proposal.

happy.desc: playbook_propose --finding <existing-finding-id> -> prints proposalId + proposalDigest; proposals/<id>.json created with lineage.sourceStoryId, lineage.sourceFindingId, lineage.sourceSignature all populated from the source finding; WHY: proves the core propose path with lineage propagation
playbook_diff <proposalId> -> renders the candidate playbook that approve would write; calling diff twice returns identical output; WHY: proves diff is read-only and deterministic
playbook_reject <proposalId> -> proposal file removed; subsequent readProposal returns not-found; WHY: proves reject discards the proposal cleanly

edge.desc: playbook_propose --finding <non-existent-finding-id> -> clear error message mentioning the finding was not found; no proposal file created; WHY: boundary for missing source finding
playbook_diff on non-existent proposalId -> clear not-found error, no crash; WHY: boundary for missing proposal
playbook_reject on non-existent proposalId -> clear not-found error, no crash; WHY: idempotent/safe reject of missing proposal
playbook_diff does NOT mutate -> snapshot proposals/ directory before and after diff; file list and contents identical; WHY: proves diff is purely read-only

adversarial.desc: after playbook_propose, assert findings.json is byte-identical to before -> propose never calls finding_add; WHY: enforces the hard guardrail that playbook lifecycle never auto-files findings
after playbook_propose, assert no gate was invoked (gate log/advisory unchanged) -> propose never touches gates; WHY: enforces the hard guardrail that playbook lifecycle never touches gates

playbook_propose called twice for same finding -> second call either overwrites with new proposalId or returns clear already-proposed error; never leaves orphaned state; WHY: adversarial duplicate-propose scenario

items.title: playbook_approve (staged, digest fail-closed) -> candidate with lineage
items.context: playbook_approve <proposalId> requires --expectedProposalDigest matching the stored proposalDigest (stale fails closed, like decision-doc). On match, writes a candidate Playbook to playbooks.json with lineage carried over and status=candidate, then clears the proposal. active status requires explicit human approval and is NOT auto-set. Guardrail: never auto-finding_add. CLI registered via command-policy/config/registry/cli-engine (flat underscore names).
items.userSees: playbook_approve with a stale digest is rejected with a clear error; with the correct digest it creates a candidate playbook in playbooks.json carrying lineage; no finding is auto-created.

happy.desc: playbook_approve <proposalId> --expectedProposalDigest <correctDigest> -> candidate Playbook written to playbooks.json with status=candidate, lineage carried from proposal, proposal file cleared; WHY: proves the core approve-with-matching-digest path
approved playbook in playbooks.json has status=candidate, NOT active -> assert status field equals candidate; WHY: proves active is never auto-set, requires explicit human approval

edge.desc: playbook_approve with stale/wrong expectedProposalDigest -> rejected with clear error mentioning digest mismatch; proposal NOT cleared; no candidate written; WHY: proves fail-closed digest integrity (the core safety property)
playbook_approve with missing expectedProposalDigest flag -> rejected with clear error; WHY: proves the flag is mandatory, not optional-defaults-to-match
playbook_approve for non-existent proposalId -> clear not-found error; no side effects; WHY: boundary for missing proposal
after successful approve, re-approve same proposalId -> not-found error (proposal already cleared); WHY: proves approve is not idempotent/replayable

adversarial.desc: after playbook_approve, assert findings.json byte-identical to before -> approve never calls finding_add; WHY: enforces the guardrail that approve never auto-files findings
after playbook_approve, assert no gate was invoked (advisory/gate logs unchanged) -> approve never touches gates; WHY: enforces the guardrail that approve never touches gates

four CLI commands (playbook_propose, playbook_diff, playbook_approve, playbook_reject) are registered in command-policy + config + registry + cli-engine with flat underscore names -> grep/import-check confirms registration; WHY: proves CLI wiring is complete and uses correct naming convention

candidate playbook lineage fields (sourceStoryId, sourceFindingId, sourceSignature) are all non-empty and match the original finding -> assert each field present and matches source; WHY: proves lineage is faithfully carried through the approve boundary, not dropped or zeroed

items.title: Smoke + npm script + no regression
items.context: tasks/experience-layer-playbook-smoke.ts + package.json test:experience-layer-playbook. Hermetic. Assert: full propose->diff->approve->reject lifecycle; proposalDigest stability + stale-digest approve fails closed; lineage present on candidate; playbook never triggers finding_add/gate; learning modules zero outward coupling (except core/digest.js); build clean; existing experience-layer + decision-doc smokes still pass.
items.userSees: npm run test:experience-layer-playbook exits 0 'smoke passed'; committed verifier prints TOTAL N | PASS N | FAIL 0; existing smokes still pass.

happy.desc: npm --prefix packages/main run test:experience-layer-playbook -> exits 0 with output containing smoke passed; WHY: proves the smoke script is wired and the full lifecycle works end-to-end
smoke exercises full propose->diff->approve->reject lifecycle in sequence -> verifier prints TOTAL N | PASS N | FAIL 0; WHY: proves all lifecycle transitions work together
existing experience-layer smoke still passes -> npm --prefix packages/main run test:experience-layer exits 0; WHY: no regression on Phase 1 experience-layer
existing decision-doc smoke still passes -> npm --prefix packages/main run test:decision-doc exits 0; WHY: no regression on decision-doc which shares core/digest.js

edge.desc: smoke is hermetic -> uses a temp directory for .lattice/learning/, does not pollute the real .lattice/; WHY: proves test isolation
smoke asserts proposalDigest stability -> compute digest, re-read proposal, digest matches; WHY: proves digest determinism within the integration test
build clean after all changes -> npm --prefix packages/main run build exits 0 with no type errors; WHY: proves types are well-formed and no compilation regressions

adversarial.desc: smoke asserts the never-auto-finding guardrail -> snapshot findings state before lifecycle, compare after full propose->diff->approve->reject, findings unchanged; WHY: integration-level proof that the entire lifecycle never auto-files findings

smoke asserts learning modules have zero outward coupling -> import analysis of experience-layer-types.ts + learning-store.ts + handlers/playbook.ts shows only core/digest.js + finding read port as external imports; WHY: non-vacuous import-fence check at integration level
